changeSet.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_daily_recon_summary AS SELECT trade_date, COUNT(*) AS total_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'MATCHED') AS matched_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('UNMATCHED','DISPUTED')) AS break_trades, COALESCE(SUM(quantity * price), 0) AS total_notional FROM trades WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY trade_date;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_daily_recon_summary_trade_date ON mv_daily_recon_summary (trade_date);

rollback.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_daily_recon_summary;
